now.title: Hawkeye#3
now.text: Wilson Fisk raises Maya Lopez as a surrogate uncle and employs her in his crime empire.

changes.evidence: In Hawkeye #3 Maya's boss is only her unnamed 'uncle'; Wilson Fisk is first revealed as Maya's 'uncle' and the Kingpin at the end of #5, when Yelena sends the photo of Eleanor with him. Naming Fisk at #3 gives that reveal away early; every other Fisk pair in this chunk starts at #5 or later.

owner_calls.question: The only stage is at Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3, but its first event (Rocket and Cosmo snarling at each other in the Collector's museum) happens in Guardians of the Galaxy (2014), and their rebuilding of Knowhere is already shown in the Holiday Special. Should the pair start earlier?
options: Keep one stage at Vol. 3 (past event told as background)
Add a stage at Guardians of the Galaxy (rival: they growl at each other in the museum) and keep Vol. 3 for the later team-up
Start at The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special (they rebuild Knowhere together) and drop the museum line
owner_calls.evidence: Cosmo article: 'In 2014, when the soon-to-be Guardians of the Galaxy were guided through the establishment by Carina, Cosmo and Rocket growled and bared their teeth at each other'; 'In December 2025, Cosmo was working with Rocket to rebuild Knowhere' (Holiday Special).
